admin.tracks.title: Courses of gates, per scene
admin.tracks.help: The courses the generator and pilots saved for everyone, hidden ones too. Hide or show a course, rename it (a new version marked as edited by the admin), delete one version or the whole course, reset votes or broken reports, or open it in the editor in a new tab. Deleting and resetting ask once more.
admin.tracks.noScenes: No course has been saved yet.
admin.tracks.reason.not-found: the course or version is gone (refresh the list)
admin.tracks.reason.invalid: the server refused the course file (for a pilot's course the title must be 3 to 60 letters, digits or simple signs)
admin.tracks.reason.too-many-versions: this course has the most versions it may have; delete an old version first
admin.tracks.reason.scene-mismatch: the file belongs to another scene
admin.tracks.hiddenNote: Hidden by you: pilots do not see it.
admin.tracks.hiddenCap: Hidden because the scene was full: pilots do not see it.
admin.tracks.openHidden: Show it to open it in the editor
admin.tracks.shownDone: The course is visible to pilots again.
admin.tracks.hiddenDone: The course is hidden from pilots.
admin.tracks.title.same: That is the title it already has.
admin.tracks.title.short: The title needs at least {min} characters.
admin.tracks.title.long: The title may have at most {max} characters.
admin.tracks.renamed: Renamed: saved as a new version, edited by the admin.
